title: F08: Budgets, savings goal, dashboard
milestone: M5 API + UI
labels: frontend, backend
---
## Goal
Scenario 2: monthly limits per category, a savings goal, and a dashboard with spending against limits and a month forecast. Includes the demo seed (moved from F09, [0022](../../docs/wiki/decisions/0022-demo-data-by-explicit-command.md)).

**Depends on:** F06, F07
**Built by:** `backend-dev` ∥ `frontend-dev`

## Decisions (2026-10-08)
- Goal progress is per month and stateless; `saved_this_month = income − projected_total` ([0021](../../docs/wiki/decisions/0021-dashboard-and-goal-semantics.md)).
- The demo seed is an explicit command through the services that only loads into an empty database ([0022](../../docs/wiki/decisions/0022-demo-data-by-explicit-command.md)).
- The Settings page covers budgets and the goal only; no item-category UI.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `GET/PUT /budgets`, `GET/PUT /goal` and `GET /insights/summary` are implemented; `/insights/leaks` stays `501` (F09); `docs/openapi.json` is unchanged
- [ ] Forecast and goal logic live in `app/domain/budget.py` with table-driven tests
- [ ] `make seed-demo` loads 3 months of demo data into an empty database and refuses a non-empty one
- [ ] On the seeded data the dashboard shows at least one `over` and one `on_pace_to_overrun` category, and goal progress
- [ ] State is shown as text, not only by colour
- [ ] Scenario 2 works by hand on the seeded demo data
